penalty_label: L2 penalty chosen per point on validation prompts (grid 1e-5 to 1; not preregistered)

assumption_grid.note: the crowd price is DERIVED (POPQUORN's $12 per hour and 13 minutes per 50 offensiveness annotations, about $0.052 each), not a published per-rating price; every other dollar figure is an assumption

definitions.note: margins and the power rule were fixed in this script before it ran; they are not in the preregistration

popquorn_offensiveness.test_items_scaling_assumption: paired sd measured with each test item's own ratings (median k); sd at other k scaled by sqrt((sc2 + sw2/k)/(sc2 + sw2/k_med)) using the single-judge loss components: an approximation, not measured for the paired difference
